Unki Launches New Platinum Concentrate Product in Zimbabwe

Zimbabwe’s Unki has announced the launch of a new platinum concentrate product at its Shurugwi operations, marking a significant development for the country’s metals and mining sector. The new product, which is aimed at both local and export markets, is expected to support Zimbabwe’s drive to increase value-added mineral exports.

Speaking at the unveiling ceremony on Tuesday, Unki Managing Director Tawanda Ndlovu said, “This new line of platinum concentrate will allow us to better respond to evolving global demand while supporting the government’s beneficiation strategy. Our investment in advanced processing technology ensures that our concentrate meets the highest industry standards.”

Unki’s Shurugwi facility, situated in the heart of Zimbabwe’s Great Dyke, has undergone a series of upgrades over the past 18 months to accommodate the new product line. According to Ndlovu, the expansion created over 80 new skilled jobs and included enhancements to environmental monitoring systems. “We are committed to responsible mining and community development. Our operations continue to set benchmarks for environmental stewardship,” he added.

Industry analysts note that Unki’s move could reinforce Zimbabwe’s position as a key player in the global platinum group metals supply chain. “With platinum prices showing resilience and demand from the automotive and technology sectors steady, this launch is timely,” said Tendai Moyo, principal analyst at the Zimbabwe Metals Review.

The Chamber of Mines of Zimbabwe welcomed the product launch, with spokesperson Chipo Mazai saying, “The sector needs more initiatives like this to stimulate growth and generate foreign currency earnings.”

Unki’s new platinum concentrate will be made available to clients immediately, with initial shipments expected to leave the Shurugwi site later this month. The company has indicated plans to further expand its product offerings in the coming year.
